title: Etale origin and constant-model transport of one finite quotient
statement: Let X be Noetherian, g:Y→X an immersion, d an adic coefficient datum on A [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], n≥0, and K a derived module over the actual nth finite coefficient ring on X [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-tower]. Suppose K is bounded and every cohomology of its inverse image along g, restricted by pbcLevelConstantComparison, is relatively finite lisse. For any etale V→Y there is L in D(V_et,C/J^(n+1)), where C is the I-adic completion of A and J=IC. Its cohomology is finite locally constant and H^q(K)=0 implies H^q(L)=0 for each q. For every etale Z→V and every algebraic E in D(C/J^(n+1)), a supplied isomorphism L|Z≅constant(E) induces an isomorphism from constantAdicQuotientRealization(W.hom≫g,d,n)(E) to the actual inverse image of K on every proetale W over Z [lem-weil-pbc-constant-adic-quotient-scalar-comparison]. The original restricted cohomology is relatively finite lisse on each proetale refinement W of V. There is no geometric point, no tower, no normalization, and no existence claim for a constant-model isomorphism.

proof.text: Apply the core single-quotient descent theorem to obtain the level, finite local constancy, vanishing reflection, and refinement lissity on V.
For an arbitrary supplied constant model on Z, apply the conditional transport theorem and assemble its result with the core fields into the requested origin structure.

lean.statement:
theorem lisse_finite_quotient_etale_origin
    (X Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X] (g : Y ⟶ X) [IsImmersion g]
    {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A) (n : ℕ)
    (K : DerivedCategory (pbcModules X ((pbcAdicRings X d).obj (op n))))
    (hbounded : ∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ q : ℤ, (q < a ∨ b < q) →
      IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj K))
    (hlisse : ∀ q : ℤ,
      IsRelativelyFiniteLisseModule g (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1))
        ((pbcRestrict ((adicTowerInverseImage g).map
          (pbcLevelConstantComparison X d n).hom)).obj
            ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj
              ((adicTowerPullback g ((pbcAdicRings X d).obj (op n))).obj K))))
    (V : Y.Etale) :
    Nonempty (LisseFiniteQuotientEtaleOrigin X Y g d n K V)
